MIX autocorrelation — r_voice at stem-derived voice lag (blue) vs r_max top in-range peak (red)
STEM reference F0 — the voice-lag seed (median 239 Hz, IQR 178-291 Hz; phrase-dependent 144-267 Hz)

Green shading = ref segments 1-10 (sung); pink = ref 11-12 (wordless-outro Demucs bleed). The voice-lag peak (blue) sits below the accompaniment peak (red) even on sung spans — no threshold separates the classes.
